71: ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਤਾ ਖੜਿ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਦੀਤ ॥੭॥
but if God does not dwell in his mind, in the end he is carried off and cast into hell. ॥7॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾੜਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
If someone's body has never known disease or any trouble, and he has no care or worry,
ਮਿਰਤੁ. ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
if death never comes to his mind and he enjoys worldly pleasures day and night,
ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਜੀਇ. ਨ ਸੰਕ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
if he has made everything his own and no doubt about owning it has ever arisen in his mind,
ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਵਸਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੮॥
but God has never come into his mind, in the end he falls into the power of Death's messengers. ॥8॥
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
The one on whom God shows mercy gains the company of the holy.
ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਓਹੁ ਵਧਾਈਐ; ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
The more sitting in that company grows, the more love for God grows.
ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪਿ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
God Himself is master of both sides, worldly attachment and love for His feet; there is no other support.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਇਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੯॥੧॥੨੬॥
O Nanak, when the true Guru is pleased, the eternal Name is obtained. ॥9॥1॥26॥
I do not know what pleases God.
O my mind, search out the path that pleases Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those who meditate sit in trance,
but only a rare one has understood God. ॥1॥
The Vaishnav devotees keep to their disciplines of fasts and rites,
the yogis say they are liberated,
and ascetics stay absorbed in their austerities. ॥2॥
sannyasis keep to renunciation and celibates to celibacy,
and the Udasis stay absorbed in their garb of detachment. ॥3॥
Some say devotion is of nine kinds;
the pandit reads the Veda aloud;
the householder stays absorbed in the householder's duty. ॥4॥
Many keep crying out to the Unseen One, some take on many guises, some go naked;
some wear special robes, some stage plays and shows to please people, some pass their nights awake;
and some bathe at every place of pilgrimage. ॥5॥
Many go without food, and some touch no one lest they be defiled;
many hide away in caves and let no one see them;
and some are wise only in their own minds. ॥6॥
None of these calls himself less than another;
all say they have found God;
but the devotee is the one whom God unites with Himself. ॥7॥
As for me, all these arguments and methods
I have given up, and I have taken God's refuge alone.
Nanak has fallen at the Guru's feet. ॥8॥2॥27॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
O Lord, dwelling within yogis, You Yourself practise yoga;
within those who enjoy Maya's pleasures, You Yourself are the one who enjoys.
ਤੇਰਾ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੁਰਗਿ ਮਛਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
No being in heaven, on earth or in the underworld has found the limit of Your virtues. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ. ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ; ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵ ਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, I am a sacrifice, I am devoted, I am given over to Your Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O Lord, You created the world;
writing each being's record of deeds on its head, You have caught them in Maya's affairs.
ਵੇਖਹਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ; ਕਰਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਿ. ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Having made creation and thrown down the creatures like dice, You Yourself watch over what You have made. ॥2॥
God is seen dwelling in this visible expanse of the world.
Every being longs for His Name,
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
but without the true Guru no one has found it, for the whole creation is caught in Maya's net. ॥3॥
One should be a sacrifice to the true Guru,
for meeting him, the highest spiritual state is attained.
72: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ; ਸੋ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
The Name that gods, men and silent sages long for, the true Guru has made me understand. ॥4॥
What kind of gathering should be known as the true company?
The one where only God's Name is praised.
ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
O Nanak, the true Guru has made it clear that repeating the one Name alone is God's command. ॥5॥
This world, caught in Maya's wandering, has strayed from life's right road.
O Lord, You Yourself have parted it from Yourself.
ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਲਗਾ, ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਭਾਗ ਜਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
Suffering clings to the unfortunate soul-brides who have no good fortune. ॥6॥
What are the marks of the unfortunate soul-brides?
They have strayed from their Husband-Lord and wander without support.
ਮੈਲੇ ਵੇਸ. ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾਮਣੀ; ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
The faces of such brides look soiled with the filth of vices, and their night of life passes in suffering. ॥7॥
What good deed have the fortunate soul-brides done?
Through impressions written by good deeds of a past birth, they have now received the fruit of the Name.
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ; ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
Casting His glance of grace, God Himself unites them with His feet. ॥8॥
Those soul-brides whom God moves to obey His command
keep the word of His praise dwelling in their hearts.
ਸਹੀਆ ਸੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ; ਜਿਨ. ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
Only those companions are fortunate whose love for their Husband-Lord endures. ॥9॥
Those who come to delight in walking in God's will
rid themselves within of Maya's wandering.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਐਸਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ; ਜੋ. ਸਭਸੈ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥
O Nanak, know the true Guru to be so kind that he unites all who come to him with God's feet. ॥10॥
By coming to the true Guru, that person has gained the taste of the Name
who has driven pride out from within.
ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ; ਭਾਗੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੧॥
The pain of an evil mind is cut away from him, and good fortune wakes on his forehead. ॥11॥
O Lord, the word of Your praise is the water that gives spiritual life;
it stays always in the hearts of Your devotees.
ਸੁਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿਐ; ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੨॥
Because Your peace-giving service dwells within them, You cast Your glance of grace and carry them across. ॥12॥
Know that the true Guru has truly been met
when by meeting him God's Name is remembered.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਸਭ ਥਕੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
Without the true Guru the Name is not found; the whole world wears itself out doing rituals. ॥13॥
I am a sacrifice to the true Guru,
who has set the one strayed in wandering on the right road of life.
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ; ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਰਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੪॥
If the Guru casts his glance of grace, he himself joins one to God's feet. ॥14॥
O Lord, You pervade all beings.
Yet that Creator has kept Himself hidden.
ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇਆ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ. ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੫॥
O Nanak, in the one within whom the Creator has revealed His light through the Guru, He becomes manifest. ॥15॥
The Master Himself has given honour to His servant;
giving him life and body, He Himself created him.
ਆਪਣੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀਆ; ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੬॥
Placing both His hands on His servant's head, He Himself has kept his honour. ॥16॥
All efforts to rule the senses and all such clever ways are left aside;
my dear Lord knows every need of His servant.
ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ; ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੭॥
God makes His servant's glory manifest, and the whole world hails him. ॥17॥
God has not weighed my virtues or my faults;
God has kept in mind only His own age-old nature.
ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ; ਲਗੈ ਨ. ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੮॥
Holding me to His bosom, He has saved me; no pain or vice can harm a hair of my head. ॥18॥
I have meditated on God in my mind and in my heart.
I have gained the fruit of the Name that my soul always longed for.
ਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਤੂੰ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੯॥
O Lord, You are Master over all kings and emperors; O Nanak, by repeating the Name one gains spiritual life. ॥19॥
73: O Lord, You Yourself revealed Yourself in the form of the world,
and You Yourself made and showed this play of Maya that seems apart from You.
ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੦॥
The eternal Lord alone is present everywhere; whomever He favours, He makes understand this. ॥20॥
The one who by the Guru's grace has grasped this secret,
from his heart God has removed attachment to Maya.
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ; ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੧॥
Showing His mercy, God Himself absorbs him into Himself. ॥21॥
O Lord, You are the milkmaid, You are the river, You are the cowherd;
You Yourself held up the earth, the Govardhan mountain.
ਹੁਕਮੀ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ. ਭੰਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੨॥
By Your command You fashion the bodies of beings; You Yourself destroy and create. ॥22॥
Those who have set their love on the true Guru
have rid themselves within of the love of Maya.
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਆ; ਓਇ ਚਲੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੩॥
The light within those persons becomes pure, and they depart having made their life clean. ॥23॥
ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਣਾ; ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੪॥੧॥
Says Nanak: God gives every gift unasked; keep that eternal Lord in your heart. ॥24॥1॥
Falling at the Guru's feet, I try to win God over.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru has united me with God; there is no other as great as He. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Master of creation is very dear to me,
sweeter even than my mother and father.
ਭੈਣ ਭਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣਾ; ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਾ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
O Lord, among sisters, brothers and all kin, there is none who loves like You. ॥1॥
By Your command the month of Sawan has come for me,
and I have yoked the plough of high conduct.
ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜਣ ਲਗਾ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਬੋਹਲ ਬਖਸ ਜਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
I began to sow Your Name, hoping that the heap of Your grace would gather. ॥2॥
Meeting the Guru, I have formed a bond with You alone;
I know no other account to write but Your Name.
ਹਰਿ ਇਕਤੈ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਓਨੁ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ. ਤਿਂਵੈ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
O Lord, You have set me to this one task; now carry it through as You please. ॥3॥
O my brothers in the holy company, you too enjoy the taste of God's Name.
The Guru has dressed me in a robe of honour in God's court,
ਹਉ ਹੋਆ ਮਾਹਰੁ ਪਿੰਡ ਦਾ; ਬੰਨਿ ਆਦੇ. ਪੰਜਿ ਸਰੀਕ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
for I have become master of my body, and have brought the five opponents under control and seated them before me. ॥4॥
O my Lord, I have come to Your refuge.
The five farmers, the senses, have become my tenants.
ਕੰਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਢਿ. ਨ ਹੰਘਈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਵੁਠਾ ਘੁਘਿ ਗਿਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
No sense dares raise its head against me; O Nanak, my body-village is now thickly settled with good virtues. ॥5॥
O Lord, I am a sacrifice, I am devoted to You.
I keep You alone, my King, in my heart.
ਉਜੜੁ ਥੇਹੁ ਵਸਾਇਓ; ਹਉ. ਤੁਧ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
You have resettled my ruined and deserted heart; I am a sacrifice to You. ॥6॥
Now I always remember the dear Lord,
and I have gained the fruit of the Name my mind longed for.
ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ; ਲਾਹੀਅਨੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
He has set all my affairs right and taken away my mind's hunger for Maya. ॥7॥
I have given up all worldly greed.
I keep remembering only the eternal Master of creation.
ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ; ਮੈ ਪਲੈ ਬਧਾ ਛਿਕਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
God's Name-treasure is the nine treasures for me; I have tied it tight in the hem of my heart. ॥8॥
I have found a spiritual peace finer than all the world's comforts.
The Guru has set the word of God's praise in my heart.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ; ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
Placing his hand on my head, the true Guru has shown me God. ॥9॥
ਮੈ ਬਧੀ; ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ਹੈ ॥
I have made sitting with the Guru's Sikhs my place of worship, where I remember the eternal Lord.
I seek out the Guru's Sikhs with care and meet them.
ਪੈਰ ਧੋਵਾ. ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰਦਾ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਗਾ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥
I wash his feet and fan him, and bowing low I fall at his feet. ॥10॥
74: Hearing of the Guru's greatness, I too have come to the Guru,
and he has fixed in my heart that remembering the Name, moving others to remember, and living a pure life is the right way.
ਸਭੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੈਸਾਰੜਾ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਚਾੜਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੧॥
O Nanak, all the world that the Guru seats in the boat of remembering the eternal Lord is saved from vices. ॥11॥
ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Lord, the whole creation serves You day and night,
for You listen closely to every prayer.
ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀਆ; ਤੁਸਿ. ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੨॥
I have tested all people thoroughly; those freed from vices, God Himself, being pleased, has freed. ॥12॥
Now the gracious Lord's command has gone forth
that no vice can trouble anyone who has come to His refuge.
ਸਭ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਵੁਠੀਆ; ਇਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
All on whom He has shown mercy dwell in spiritual bliss; within each, this rule of humility has been established. ॥13॥
Bringing stillness of mind, the nectar of God's Name rains gently within me.
Moved by the Master, I speak words of His praise.
ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ. ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਰੇ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਥਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੪॥
I have always taken pride in You alone; You Yourself will accept me. ॥14॥
O Lord, Your devotees always hunger for the sight of You.
O Lord, fulfil this longing of mine too.
ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ. ਸੁਖਦਾਤਿਆ; ਮੈ. ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ, ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੫॥
O Giver of peace, grant me the sight of You and clasp me to Your embrace. ॥15॥
No other as great as You can be found.
O Lord, You dwell in all lands, all realms and the underworlds.
ਤੂੰ ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਗਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੬॥
You pervade every place; O Nanak, the eternal Name is the support of the devotees. ॥16॥
I was a little, untried wrestler of the Master,
but meeting the Guru I have come to wear a high turban.
ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ਛਿੰਝ ਇਕਠੀਆ; ਦਯੁ ਬੈਠਾ. ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੭॥
All beings have gathered in the world's arena, and the dear Lord Himself sits watching. ॥17॥
Bugles, drums and kettledrums are sounding;
the wrestlers have gathered and are circling round the ring.
ਨਿਹਤੇ ਪੰਜਿ ਜੁਆਨ ਮੈ; ਗੁਰ ਥਾਪੀ ਦਿਤੀ ਕੰਡਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੮॥
When the Guru patted me on the back, I overcame the five young wrestlers. ॥18॥
All have come together, taking human birth,
but they will go to the home beyond by different roads, into different births.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਗਏ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਚਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੯॥
Those who follow the Guru leave having earned the profit of the Name; those who follow their own mind go having lost even their capital. ॥19॥
O Lord, You have no particular colour or marks,
yet, O Lord, You are seen plainly present in all the world.
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ; ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੦॥
Hearing Your praises again and again, Your devotees remember You; O treasure of virtues, they stay dyed in Your love. ॥20॥
I always keep serving that dear Lord.
The Guru has cut my noose of attachment to Maya.

ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਸਮਾਲੈ; ਜਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
He never keeps in his heart the Lord's Name, which is a companion at the end.
77: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਝੂਠੀ; ਅੰਤਿ. ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
This wealth, property and Maya do not last; at the end he leaves them behind and departs in regret.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ. ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ; ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
One on whom the Lord has mercy is led to the Guru, and he keeps the Lord's Name in his heart.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ; ਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
Says Nanak: in the third watch, those who keep the Name go and merge with the Lord. ॥3॥
ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ, ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਚਲਣ ਵੇਲਾ ਆਦੀ ॥
O friend who came to trade in the Name, in the fourth watch of life's night the Lord brings the time to depart.
ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ, ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਸਭ ਚਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਦੀ ॥
O trader friend, take the true Guru's refuge, knowing him to be infallible; the whole night of life is passing.
ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ, ਢਿਲ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਕਰਿਹੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ. ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਹੋਵਹੁ ॥
Remember the Lord with every breath and do not delay at all, so that you may gain a spiritual life steady for ever.
ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਰਲੀਆ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਖੋਵਹੁ ॥
You will enjoy union with the Lord for ever and end the sorrows of birth and death.
ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ. ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਂਦੀ ॥
Know no difference between the Guru and the Lord; joined to the Guru, devotion to the Lord becomes dear.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ, ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ; ਸਫਲਿਓੁ ਰੈਣਿ. ਭਗਤਾ ਦੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
Says Nanak: for devotees who keep up devotion even in the fourth watch, the whole night of life bears fruit. ॥4॥1॥3॥
ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ. ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਧਰਿ ਪਾਇਤਾ ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
O friend who came to trade in the Name, in the first watch of life's night God places the being in the mother's womb.
ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ. ਮਾਨਸੁ ਕੀਆ, ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਕਰਿ ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
O trader friend, in ten months He shapes a human being and grants a fixed span in which beings do their deeds.
ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ. ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ; ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
He sets the span of life, and beings do such deeds as the lot He writes on their foreheads from the start.
ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ; ਤਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੰਜੋਇਆ ॥
Mother, father, brother, son and wife: God absorbs the being among these.
ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ. ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ; ਇਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ. ਵਸਿ. ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
God Himself makes him do good and bad deeds; nothing is in this creature's power.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ; ਧਰਿ ਪਾਇਤਾ ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Says Nanak: in the first watch God places the person in the mother's womb. ॥1॥
ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ. ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਭਰਿ ਜੁਆਨੀ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
O friend who came to trade in the Name, in the second watch of life's night youth at its height surges in waves.
ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ. ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ, ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਮਨੁ ਮਤਾ ਅਹੰਮੇਇ ॥
O trader friend, his mind is drunk with pride, and he cannot tell bad from good.
ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ. ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ; ਆਗੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
A person does not see whether what he does is good or bad, and in the world beyond he walks a hard road.
ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਸਿਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰਾ ॥
He never takes the refuge of the perfect true Guru, and cruel messengers of Death stand over his head.
ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਪਕਰਸਿ ਬਵਰੇ; ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
When the righteous judge seizes the crazed one, what answer will he give then?
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ; ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
Says Nanak: in the second watch youth at its height surges in waves. ॥2॥
ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ. ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
O friend who came to trade in the Name, in the third watch of life's night, blinded and without understanding, a person gathers the poison of wealth.
ਪੁਤ੍ਰਿ ਕਲਤ੍ਰਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਿਆ, ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਲੋਭਾਨੁ ॥
O trader friend, he is entangled in attachment to son and wife, and waves of greed rise within him.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਲੋਭਾਨੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Waves of greed rise within the person, and that God never comes to his mind.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ. ਨ ਕੀਆ; ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
He does not join the company of the holy, and suffers pain in many births.
ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਲਗੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
He forgets the Creator, his Master, and not for a blink does he fix his attention on Him.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ; ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੇ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
Says Nanak: in the third watch the blind, ignorant person gathers poison. ॥3॥
ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ. ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
O friend who came to trade in the Name, in the fourth watch of life's night that day of departure draws near.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ. ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
O trader friend, keep the Name in your heart through the Guru; it will be your helper in the Lord's court.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ; ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
O person, keep the Name in your heart through the Guru; in the end it is your companion.
78: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ. ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ, ਨ ਚਾਲੈ; ਝੂਠੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
This attachment to Maya will not go with you; the love you have given it is false.
ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ. ਗੁਦਰੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ; ਸੇਵਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
The whole night of life is passing in darkness; take the true Guru's refuge, and light will dawn.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ; ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
Says Nanak: O person, in the fourth watch that day draws near. ॥4॥
ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ. ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਉਠਿ ਚਲੇ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
O friend who came to trade in the Name, when the Lord's written summons comes, the deeds one has earned go along.
ਇਕ ਰਤੀ. ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਦੇਵਨੀ, ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਓਨੀ ਤਕੜੇ ਪਾਏ ਹਾਥ ॥
O trader friend, they allow not a moment's delay; they have laid a firm grip on him.
ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ. ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
When the written order comes, they seize him and drive him on; those who follow their own minds are always in misery.
ਜਿਨੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਸੇ. ਦਰਗਹ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
Those who have kept the support of the perfect true Guru are always at ease in the Lord's court.
ਕਰਮ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਰੀਰੁ, ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਜੋ ਬੋਵੈ. ਸੋ ਖਾਤਿ ॥
In human life the body is the field for deeds; whatever one sows, that he eats.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਵਾਰੇ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਤਿ ॥੫॥੧॥੪॥
Says Nanak: the devotees shine at the Lord's door, while those who follow their own minds are forever cast into the round of birth and death. ॥5॥1॥4॥

One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ. ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖੈ ॥
If the soul-bride stays innocent in her parents' home, this human birth, how can she behold her Husband-Lord?
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕੰਮ ਸਿਖੈ ॥
When the Lord shows His mercy, she turns to the Guru and learns the tasks that bring her to her Husband's feet.
ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ. ਕੰਮ ਸਿਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
Turning to the Guru she learns the tasks for reaching the Lord's presence: she meditates on the Lord for ever.
ਸਹੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਏ ॥
She moves at ease among her companions, and goes carefree into the Lord's presence.
ਲੇਖਾ. ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ, ਕਿਰਖੈ ॥
By repeating the Lord's Name she settles the righteous judge's account and all that is owed.
ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦਿਖੈ ॥੧॥
The innocent bride, in her parents' home, beholds the Lord through the Guru. ॥1॥
ਵੀਆਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
O my father, I am married; through the Guru I have found the Lord.
ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ॥
The darkness of ignorance is cut away, for the Guru's wisdom blazes bright.
ਬਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
The Guru's wisdom shone, the darkness was dispelled, and I found the precious jewel of the Lord's Name.
ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ. ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ; ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ. ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖਾਧਾ ॥
Following the Guru's teaching, the disease of pride has gone and its pain is over; knowing myself, my sense of self has ended.
ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ. ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੈ. ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
I have found the Husband whom death cannot touch, who is imperishable, who neither dies nor is born.
ਵੀਆਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
O my father, through the Guru I am married and have found the Lord. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤੇ. ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ. ਜੰਞ ਸੁਹੰਦੀ ॥
O my father, the Lord is eternal, eternal; His devotees gathering together make a fine wedding party.
ਪੇਵਕੜੈ. ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ; ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਖਰੀ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ॥
In her parents' home, this human life, repeating the Lord's Name she lives in comfort, and in the world beyond she is greatly honoured.
ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਰੀ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ; ਜਿਨਿ ਪੇਵਕੜੈ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
She who kept the Name in her heart in her parents' home is surely honoured in the world beyond.
ਸਭੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ, ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਿਆ ॥
Through the Guru, the whole life of those bears fruit who have conquered their minds and played this chaupar game of life.
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ. ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ; ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ ॥
Meeting the Lord's saints, the union is made beautiful, and one finds the all-pervading Husband, the source of bliss.
ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ. ਜੰਞ ਸੋੁਹੰਦੀ ॥੩॥
O my father, the Lord is eternal, eternal; His devotees gathering together make a fine wedding party. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ; ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਦਾਜੋ ॥
O my father, give me the gift of the Lord God's Name; give me this as my dowry.
79: ਹਰਿ ਕਪੜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਸਵਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਾਜੋ ॥
Give me the Lord's Name as clothes and the Lord's Name as wealth, so that my wedding may be made beautiful.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਾਜੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ; ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਦਾਨੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
By devotion to the Lord the wedding becomes joyful; she to whom the Guru, the true Guru, has given this gift,
ਖੰਡਿ ਵਰਭੰਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ; ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ. ਨ ਰਲੈ ਰਲਾਇਆ ॥
is honoured in her land and through the world; this gift cannot be matched by any other.
ਹੋਰਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ. ਦਾਜੁ ਜਿ ਰਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਹਿ; ਸੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਚੁ ਪਾਜੋ ॥
The dowry that others who follow their own minds set out for display is false pride, worthless as glass, a mere show.
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ; ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਦਾਜੋ ॥੪॥
O my father, give me the gift of the Lord God's Name; give me this as my dowry. ॥4॥
ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ. ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ; ਪਿਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਨ. ਵੇਲ ਵਧੰਦੀ ॥
O my father, meeting her Husband, the Lord, the soul-bride's line goes on.
ਹਰਿ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੋ, ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੋ; ਸਦ ਪੀੜੀ ਗੁਰੂ. ਚਲੰਦੀ ॥
From ages beyond count the line of the Guru, the Husband-Lord, has come down.
ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਪੀੜੀ ਚਲੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ; ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
In every age the true Guru's line goes on: those who through the Guru have remembered the Name are his line.
ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ. ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਾਵੈ; ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
The Lord is a Husband who never perishes or dies; He gives for ever, and His giving keeps growing.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ॥
O Nanak, the devotees and the Lord are one; repeating the Lord's Name the soul-bride grows beautiful in life.
ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ; ਪਿਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਧਨ. ਵੇਲ ਵਧੰਦੀ ॥੫॥੧॥
O my father, meeting her Husband, the Lord, the soul-bride's line goes on. ॥5॥1॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
O my dear mind, my friend, keep God's Name safe within you.
ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਿਬਹੈ. ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
O dear mind, O friend, the Lord's Name will stay by you for ever.
ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
Meditate on the Lord's Name, your companion and helper; whoever does so does not leave empty-handed.
ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
Fix your mind on the Lord's lotus feet, and you will gain all the fruits your mind desires.
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
The Lord of the world pervades water and land, and looks with grace on every heart.
ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
O dear mind, Nanak gives you this teaching: in the company of the holy, burn away your wandering. ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
O dear mind, O friend, without the Lord all this spread of the world is not lasting.
ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਬਿਖੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
O dear mind, O friend, this world is an ocean full of poison.
ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਕਰਤੇ; ਸਹਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
Make the Creator's lotus feet your ship, and no dread or pain can take hold of you.
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
One of great fortune who meets the perfect Guru remembers God all eight watches.
ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਭਗਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥
From the beginning, from the start of the ages, the Lord has protected His servants; the Name is the support of the devotees' lives.
ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਝੂਠ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
O dear mind, Nanak gives you this teaching: apart from the Lord's Name, all the spread of the world is not lasting. ॥2॥
ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਲਦੇ ਖੇਪ ਸਵਲੀ ॥
O dear mind, O friend, load up the cargo of the Lord's Name; this trade brings profit.
ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਮਲੀ ॥
O dear mind, O friend, hold fast to the Lord's door; that door alone is unshakeable.
ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ. ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵੇ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਆਸਣੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
One who keeps to the door of the unseen, unfathomable Lord gains a spiritual seat that never wavers.
ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣੁ, ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ; ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
There, there is no birth or death, no coming and going; all dread and pain are wiped away.
ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤ ਕਾ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਫਾਰਿਆ; ਜਮਦੂਤਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਲੀ ॥
He tears up Chitr Gupt's ledger, and the messengers of Death have no power over him.
ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਹਰਿ ਲਦੇ ਖੇਪ ਸਵਲੀ ॥੩॥
O dear mind, Nanak gives you this teaching: load up the cargo of the Lord's Name; this trade brings profit. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥
O dear mind, O friend, make your dwelling in the company of the saints.
ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਪਰਗਾਸੋ ॥
O dear mind, O friend, repeating the Lord's Name, spiritual light dawns within.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ. ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ; ਇਛ ਸਗਲੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
Remembering the Master who brings peace, all desires are fulfilled.
80: ਪੁਰਬੇ ਕਮਾਏ. ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਪਾਏ; ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
Through good deeds of past lives one finds the Lord of Lakshmi; the Lord, separated so long, is met again.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਰਬਤਿ ਰਵਿਆ; ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਬਿਸੁਆਸੋ ॥
Faith wells up in the mind that He pervades within and without, everywhere.
ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੋ ॥੪॥
Nanak gives this advice, O beloved mind: dwell in the company of the saints. ॥4॥
ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ. ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
O my dear mind, my friend, one whose mind is absorbed in loving devotion to the Lord,
ਮਨ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ. ਜੀਵੇ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
O my dear mind, my friend, meeting the Lord lives as the fish lives on meeting water.
ਹਰਿ ਪੀ ਆਘਾਨੇ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੇ; ਸ੍ਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮਨ ਵੁਠੇ ॥
Drinking the nectar of His praise, such a one is satisfied, and all comforts come to dwell in the mind.
ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਪਾਏ. ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਏ; ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੇ ॥
He finds the Lord of Lakshmi and sings songs of joy; his desires are fulfilled, for the True Guru is pleased.
ਲੜਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਲਾਏ, ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ; ਨਾਉ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
The Master has attached him to His robe and given him His Name — all wealth — as if the nine treasures were found.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਸਮਝਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ. ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੫॥੧॥੨॥
O Nanak, one to whom the saints have taught this lesson has a mind absorbed in loving devotion to the Lord. ॥5॥1॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਠ ਮਝਾਹੂ, ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ; ਪਸੇ ਕਿਉ. ਦੀਦਾਰ ॥
My Beloved is within my heart; how can I behold His sight?
ਸੰਤ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਲਭਣੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the Support of the breath of life is found in the sanctuary of the saints. ॥1॥
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਰੀਤਿ. ਸੰਤਨ ਮਨਿ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
The way of loving the Lord's lotus feet dwells in the minds of the saints.
ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਬਿਪਰੀਤਿ; ਅਨੀਤਿ. ਦਾਸਾ ਨਹ ਭਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
Love of another seems perverse and unjust to the Lord's servants; they do not like it.
ਦਾਸਾ ਨਹ ਭਾਵਏ. ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਾਵਏ; ਇਕ ਖਿਨੁ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
Nothing without His sight pleases the servants; how can they be patient for even an instant?
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨਾ. ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੀਨਾ; ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਜਿਉ ਮਰੈ ॥
Without the Name, body and mind waste away; they die like a fish without water.
ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ. ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੇ; ਗੁਣ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
Meet me, my Beloved, Support of my life, so that joining the company of the holy I may sing Your praises.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ. ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥੧॥
O Master of Nanak, show Your grace, that with mind and body I may stay merged in Your embrace. ॥1॥
ਸੋਹੰਦੜੋ ਹਭ ਠਾਇ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਡੂਜੜੋ ॥
He is beautiful in every place; no one else at all is seen.
O Nanak, meeting the True Guru, the closed doors of the mind open. ॥1॥
ਤੇਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ ਅਪਾਰ, ਸੰਤਨ ਆਧਾਰ; ਬਾਣੀ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
O incomparable, infinite Lord, Support of the saints, they reflect on Your words and the Bani of Your praise.
ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ. ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਸੁਆਸ; ਕਿਉ. ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
Remembering You with every breath and morsel, they come to full faith: why should He ever be forgotten from the mind?
ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬੇਸਾਰੀਐ. ਨਿਮਖ ਨਹੀ ਟਾਰੀਐ; ਗੁਣਵੰਤ. ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥
O Treasure of virtues, life of the saints, why forget You from the mind? Do not put Him aside even for an instant.
ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਦੇਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
The Master grants the fruits the mind desires, and cares for the pain of every soul.
ਅਨਾਥ ਕੇ ਨਾਥੇ. ਸ੍ਰਬ ਕੈ ਸਾਥੇ; ਜਪਿ. ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
O Master of the masterless, Companion of all, chanting Your Name, one does not lose this life in a gamble.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ; ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ. ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
This is Nanak's prayer to God: show mercy and carry me across the terrifying world-ocean. ॥2॥
ਧੂੜੀ ਮਜਨੁ. ਸਾਧ ਖੇ; ਸਾਈ ਥੀਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Those on whom the Master is merciful get to bathe in the dust of the feet of the holy.
ਲਧੇ ਹਭੇ ਥੋਕੜੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, those who obtain the wealth of the Lord's Name have obtained all good things. ॥1॥
ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਧਾਮ. ਭਗਤਹ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ; ਆਸਾ ਲਗਿ ਜੀਵਤੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Master's beautiful feet are the resting place of the devotees; they live on the hope of staying there.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨੇ ਗਲਤਾਨ. ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਤੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Remembering God's Name, they are absorbed in it with mind and body, and drink the Lord's life-giving nectar.
